# One command registry

Refactor the console and HTTP command adapters onto `src/commands.ts`. It must export `resolveCommand(input: string): Command | undefined`, `executeCommand(command: Command, payload: string): string`, and the erasable `Command` type `{name: "list" | "show" | "delete"; mutating: boolean}`. Resolve after trimming surrounding whitespace and lowercasing: list/ls => list (mutating false), show/get => show (false), delete/rm => delete (true); unknown or empty input returns undefined. Each resolution returns a fresh object, so callers cannot corrupt later resolutions. Execution returns `items`, `item:<payload>`, or `deleted:<payload>` for the three canonical names; payload is used literally without trimming.

Keep `runCli(argv: string[]): {code: number; output: string}` in cli.ts: argv[0] is command, argv[1] is payload (default empty), ignore later args. Unknown => `{code:2, output:"unknown command"}`; show/delete with missing OR empty payload => `{code:2,output:"missing id"}`; list ignores payload. Successful execution => code 0 and execution string. Keep `dispatch(request: {command: string; payload?: string; authorized?: boolean}): {status: number; body: string}` in http.ts: unknown => 404/"unknown command"; recognized mutating command without authorized===true => 403/"forbidden" (this precedes payload validation); show/delete empty or missing payload => 400/"missing id"; success => 200 and execution string. No input mutation.

Both adapters must import and use the shared resolve/execute API, removing their duplicated command lookup/formatting helpers. Remove the old public `findCommand` export from BOTH adapters; this is an intentional breaking API cleanup, not a compatibility shim. Migrate `src/batch.ts` from `findCommand` to `resolveCommand`: `describeCommands(inputs)` returns canonical names or "?", preserving order and duplicates. Existing CLI/HTTP entry APIs and batch signature stay intact. Tests run with `node --test test/*.test.ts`.
